nodes.rationale: Written forge-independent; forge AI features are settings derived from it, not part of it.

nodes.label: Domain Docs guide (CONTEXT.md, docs/adr/)
nodes.rationale: Proceed silently if files are absent; /domain-modeling creates them lazily. Use glossary vocabulary and flag ADR conflicts explicitly.

nodes.label: AI contribution policy (AI_POLICY.md)
nodes.rationale: So reviewers know what they are looking at and someone stays accountable for every change.

nodes.label: ADR 0001: Agents never merge, enforced by policy rather than required approvals
nodes.norm_label: adr 0001: agents never merge, enforced by policy rather than required approvals
nodes.rationale: Single maintainer; GitHub forbids self-approval and Maintainer agents push as the maintainer's account, so a required approval would block every solo PR without distinguishing agent work. Rulesets can't condition on author. Written rule now, identity-based enforcement later.

nodes.label: ADR 0002: On Gitea, an Agent account and merge whitelist enforce agents never merge
nodes.norm_label: adr 0002: on gitea, an agent account and merge whitelist enforce agents never merge
nodes.rationale: Enforcement depends on who is pushing, not on the approval count; agent work becomes distinguishable from the maintainer's. GitHub is unchanged and ADR 0001 still applies there.
